ideas.pitch: An automated visual asset optimization and transformation pipeline that uses Cloudinary's programmable APIs to generate responsive image and video sets instantly during continuous integration.
ideas.title: CloudinaryMediaPipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the explicit sponsor technology requirement for Cloudinary-powered tech while offering a tangible workflow improvement for frontend developers.

ideas.pitch: A developer tool that automatically aggregates git commit histories, pull requests, and Cloudinary upload metrics into structured Notion databases to maintain live hackathon documentation.
ideas.title: NotionJourneySync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the mandatory rule to document the entire building journey on Notion by automating the tedious parts, making judges' review processes frictionless.

ideas.pitch: An open-source media asset management CLI that tags and categorizes large repositories of images using Cloudinary AI vision capabilities and stores metadata in structured local indexes.
ideas.title: OpenSourceMediaTagger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the SheBuilds Delhi open-source building experience ethos and leverages Cloudinary vision features directly relevant to sponsors.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web component library that integrates with Cloudinary to dynamically serve responsive video players and image formats based on device capability and network speed.
ideas.title: CloudinaryResponsiveEmbeds
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on Cloudinary-powered technology integration with immediate utility for web developers attending the grand finale at PWIOI.

ideas.pitch: A live project showcase platform that syncs team documentation from Notion and embeds interactive media assets hosted on Cloudinary for instant judging evaluation.
ideas.title: HackathonLogAndShowcase
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines both core requirements—Cloudinary integration and Notion documentation—into a single meta-tool that organizers and judges can use to review submissions.
